L1.text: A man snuck into Kevin's apartment every night and stole exactly one sock. Always the left one.

L2.text: The first week, Kevin doesn't notice. I mean, who counts their socks?

L3.text: But after a month, he has thirty right socks. And not a single left one.

L5.text: The officer looks at the socks. Then at Kevin.

L6.text: And goes: so someone stole your left socks?

L7.text: He laughs all the way back to his car.

L8.text: Now Kevin chains up his washing machine every night. But every morning, another sock is gone.

L9.text: So he lies down next to the drying rack with a flashlight, and waits.

L11.text: In the morning, Kevin wakes up. And his socks are gone. The ones he was wearing.

L12.text: Kevin gives up. He walks into the little sock shop on the corner and buys new ones. For three hundred dollars.

L13.text: The owner smiles. He already knows Kevin's shoe size.

L14.text: Because he's the man. For a whole year, he's been stealing left socks all over town. Every single night.

L15.text: In the storage room behind the shop, there are ten thousand left socks.

L16.text: And Kevin? He's his best customer.
